subject: Post-demo: Redwood inference follow-up & stakeholder map
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@orion-systems.com>, Emily Stone <emily.stone@orion-systems.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Redwood inference follow-up & stakeholder map

Thanks again for taking the demo today  really appreciate Daniel and Emily walking us through your latency requirements and deployment constraints. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Recap from today
  - Primary need: reduce per-token cost for live chat while keeping 95p latency < 150ms.
  - Important constraints: on-prem private deployment for PHI-containing workflows; SOC 2 evidence required.
  - Workload profile: 70% short chat sessions (<=128 tokens), 30% long form (up to 1k tokens).

- Key decision criteria you mentioned
  - Cost per 1k tokens at production throughput
  - Security/compliance (SOC 2 + KMS integration)
  - Predictable SLA and support for dedicated GPU pools

- Request: confirm who the economic buyer and budget owner are so we can schedule a short alignment call and share a tailored pricing/commitment plan. Based on our notes, we think the budget owner is likely Rajesh Singh (CFO) and procurement should be included for contract steps. Can you confirm?

Next steps I propose:
1) Intro email to economic buyer + procurement to align on budget, timing and procurement checklist (30 min)
2) Share short pricing estimate and security pack (attached)
3) If budget/terms look reasonable, schedule a technical handoff with Rishi for onboarding runbook

I'm attaching a brief pricing estimate and our security pack for your procurement team. If you can confirm the right contact and availability for next week, we'll send a calendar invite.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-estimate.pdf, redwood-security-pack.zip

Best,
Marissa Cole

Please include Rajesh and procurement and we can lock something in.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rajesh Singh <rajesh.singh@orion-systems.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@orion-systems.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@orion-systems.com>, Emily Stone <emily.stone@orion-systems.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: budget alignment for Redwood deployment (Orion Systems)

Hi Rajesh (and procurement team) 

Per Daniel's note, looping you in to align on budget and procurement timelines for the Redwood pilot. Quick context: we demo'd last week and outlined a dedicated/private deployment option designed to meet your SOC 2 and on-prem requirements. I've attached a short pricing estimate and our security pack for procurement to review. 

Ask: can we schedule a 30-minute budget alignment call next week to run through:
- Estimated run-rate at target throughput and suggested reserved capacity commit levels
- Contracting model (monthly reserved vs annual) and discount tiers
- Procurement checklist (SOC 2 report, KMS/HSM integration details, SLAs)

Proposed slots (30 min):
- Tue 27 Apr 10:00-11:00 PT
- Wed 28 Apr 14:00-15:00 PT
- Thu 29 Apr 09:00-10:00 PT

If none of those work, share a preferred time and we'll accommodate. Also, procurement  if you have a security questionnaire or portal link, please send it our way and we'll get the SOC 2 + architecture docs uploaded.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-estimate.pdf, redwood-security-pack.zip

Thanks and looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Thanks Marissa  appreciate the intro and the docs. I can do Wed 28 Apr 14:00-14:30 PT. Procurement  can you confirm they received the security pack and confirm any additional items you need?

Procurement items we need before we sign off on budget:
- Standard SOW template and sample contract language for a reserved capacity engagement
- Clear pricing tiers by commit level and cancellation terms
- SOC 2 report and an architecture diagram showing on-prem connectivity and KMS options

Marissa  if you can get the SOW and the sample clause around data residency/KMS to procurement, that will help speed us up.

Thanks,
Rajesh Singh
CFO
Orion Systems
